label: Reduce
invalidTarget: Choose a target between {{min, count}} and {{max, count}} triangles.
nothingToDo: The scan has no more triangles than the target.
hint: Reducing takes a few seconds. Fits and regions are carried over to the reduced scan.
help: Enter the target count. Flat areas lose triangles first; edges and fillets are kept. A reduced scan makes selecting and fitting faster; very fine details can be lost.
